_README: Copy this file to build/smtp-config.json (gitignored) and fill it in, then run: node cloud/scripts/supabase-apply-smtp.mjs
_gmail_setup: Free relay, no domain needed: enable 2-Step Verification on the Google account, then Google Account > Security > App passwords > generate a 16-char password. host/user/sender = that gmail, pass = the app password.
